description: Duplicate a page item on the same page, optionally placing the copy at x/y; returns the copy ID

itemIndex.description: Index of the page item to duplicate, in page.allPageItems as numbered by list_page_items (nested items included)

x.description: X of the duplicate's top-left corner, in mm from the page left edge

y.description: Y of the duplicate's top-left corner, in mm from the page top edge
